faq.q: Can I schedule an appointment online?
faq.a: Yes, you can request an appointment any time, even after hours or on weekends. We get your request and follow up directly to confirm the details.

faq.q: What should I do in a dental emergency?
faq.a: Call us at +1-980-498-1037 for same-day emergency treatment. We handle dental pain, injuries, and urgent problems. You can also request an appointment online and mention the emergency.
